items: The American continent has three regions: North America, Central America and South America.
The United States, Canada, Alaska, and Mexico are in North America.
Panama, Belice, Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua and the Caribbean Islands are in Central America.
Venezuela, Colombia, Brazil, Guyana, Ecuador, Bolivia, Chile, Uruguay, Paraguay, and Argentina are in South America.

lines: 1. There are different ways to travel around the world.
2. People that travel long distances usually travel by plane.
3. They also travel by car or by bus in long distances.
4. Some people prefer to travel by car, by bus or by train.
5. People who cross the sea sometimes go by ship.
6. There are others who travel by bicycle or even on foot.
7. Astronauts use spaceships to travel into space.
